name: GPS receivers and modules
summary: Satellite position receivers: car sat-navs, handhelds, marine plotters, trackers and small modules inside phones and gadgets.
uses: Knowing where you are and planning routes offline
Adding position to a radio, tracker or computer project
identify: Car sat-navs, hiking handhelds, marine chartplotters, fitness watches, dash cams, phones and fleet trackers all have one. Modules are small boards with a square ceramic patch antenna, often marked NEO-6M or similar, with a serial (TX/RX) output.
test: Take it outside under open sky and wait: a cold start can take 1–15 minutes to get a fix. A position that holds steady to within about 10 m means it works.

decay.note: Receivers last. Accuracy depends on the satellites being maintained and may drift if ground control stops.
